name: Walmart App
optimize_description: The Walmart shopping app preinstalled on Onn devices. Nothing on the TV depends on it, so turning it off simply takes it out of the app list.

name: Home Recommendations
optimize_description: Removes extra recommendation rows (older Android TV launcher only). No effect on custom or Google TV launchers.

name: Overscan Calibrator
optimize_description: The setup tool that shrinks the picture when a TV crops the edges of the screen. Disabling only hides the tool — any calibration already applied stays — so keep it if your edges are still cut off.
restore_description: Brings back the overscan calibration tool.

name: Droidlogic Launcher Provider
optimize_description: Feeds app rows and artwork to the stock launcher on Amlogic-based devices (Onn and many budget boxes). Disabling it while that launcher is still in use empties its home screen, so only turn it off once a custom launcher is running.
restore_description: Restores the data feed the stock Amlogic launcher's home screen reads.

name: Google TV Home
optimize_description: The Google TV home screen. Disabling it with no other launcher active leaves the TV with nowhere to land on Home — install and set a replacement on the Launcher tab first.
restore_description: Restores the Google TV home screen.
